svg.title: Stress-test the frozen two-modality model
svg.desc: Test-group membership and labels are unchanged. Additional B measurements are removed in nested sets using a separate fixed seed. The training imputer, scale, model and calibration remain frozen. All cases remain in evaluation; the single-modality A model is unchanged. This probes only the specified missingness intervention.
